comment: Third-party components in the shipped program, one entry each, with where its licence text comes from. tools/gen_notices.py turns this into NOTICES.txt for a package (docs/THIRD_PARTY.md, 'Binary-release obligations'). A text is a file ('file'), the first existing of several ('any_of'), or the lines of a source comment from the line holding 'from' to the line holding 'to', with the comment's leading ' * ' removed ('extract'). A missing file is an error. 'platforms' limits an entry to linux, windows, android, ios or macos packages (default: all five).

components.name: SDL3
components.used_for: window, input, audio output; shipped as libSDL3.so.0 / SDL3.dll beside the program; statically linked on Apple platforms

components.name: SDL3 (with its Android Java code, org.libsdl.app)
components.used_for: window, input, audio output and the app's Android activity; shipped as libSDL3.so and the app's Java code

components.name: libadrenotools
components.used_for: loading a graphics driver the player adds on an Adreno phone; compiled into libmain.so, with its hook libraries libmain_hook.so, libhook_impl.so and libfile_redirect_hook.so beside it

components.name: liblinkernsbypass
components.used_for: libadrenotools' access to Android's library namespaces, compiled into libmain.so and the hook libraries

components.name: LLVM libc++ (the Android NDK's C++ runtime)
components.licence: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; older parts University of Illinois/NCSA or MIT
components.used_for: the C++ runtime of libadrenotools, linked into libmain.so and the hook libraries
